title: Ludum Dare game description and thumbnail

turns.prompt:
Create a short, descriptive but funny/twisted one sentence as ludum dare description 
Make a thumbnail for download
turns.reply:
**Description** (one sentence, ready to paste):

> You beat Pac-Man, so now you climb inside the cabinet and chomp your way down through the circuit board, the CPU and the RAM until you reach the wires, because apparently eating the dots wasn't enough and you have to eat the machine too.

A shorter option if you'd like one:

> Eat all the dots, then crawl inside the arcade cabinet and keep eating, layer by layer, until there's nothing left of the old tech but wires and regret.

**Thumbnail:** I sent you `cover/layers-of-pac-cover.png` as a file card above; save it from there. It's 640x512, the size ldjam.com recommends for the cover, so it shouldn't get cropped. I built it from Max's existing sprites: the title, the ghosts chasing Pac toward the cabinet, three of the board chips, and the tagline "EAT THE DOTS. THEN EAT THE MACHINE." On the phone, tap Upload under Cover Image and pick that file.

The image is committed in PR https://github.com/fischerq/ludumdare60/pull/86. Plan usage is 8% of the 5-hour limit and 30% of the weekly limit.
progress_notes: Capturing scene screenshots to build a 640x512 cover image from the game's layers.

turns.prompt: Do another iteration of the thumbnail
turns.reply:
I made a second cover, `cover/layers-of-pac-cover-2.png`, and sent it to you as a file card above (same 640x512 size). It's built around the new start screen that just landed on main, where the arcade machine stands on a big layer cake whose layers are the game's layers. That makes the title's joke clear at a glance.

- **Left side:** the title "LAYERS OF PAC" stacked on three lines, the ghosts chasing Pac below it, and the tagline "EAT THE DOTS. / THEN EAT THE MACHINE. / EVERY. SINGLE. LAYER."
- **Right side:** the machine on the cake, from the icing down through the maze, circuit board and binary layers. I replaced "TAP TO START" on the machine's screen with two ghosts, since that text looks odd on a cover.

The cake is shrunk from a screenshot of the start screen, so it's a little softer than the pixel-sharp sprites. That shouldn't show at thumbnail size. The first version is still in `cover/` if you prefer it.

Both covers are committed in https://github.com/fischerq/ludumdare60/pull/86. Plan usage is 10% of the 5-hour limit and 31% of the weekly limit.
